issues: The cycle detection logic incorrectly adds 1 operation for EVERY cycle in the mapping graph. A cycle only requires an extra operation to break if it is a "pure cycle" (i.e., a weakly connected component consisting entirely of the cycle). If a component has tree edges pointing into the cycle, we can strategically use one of those tree characters as a temporary buffer to break the cycle for free, avoiding the +1 cost. The original code overcounts operations for such cases (e.g., `S = "abc"`, `T = "baa"` would output 4 instead of 3).
The use of `sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()` with manual `.decode()` can be cleanly simplified to just `sys.stdin.read().split()`.
